title: Local perfect charts for one universal direct-image rank condition
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, with universally invertible structure-sheaf adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $E,F$ be finite locally free modules on $X$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Use derived categories of the scheme module categories and their open over-sites in one universe [def-pc-derived-category]. For every $s\in S$ there exist an open neighbourhood $U$, a perfect object $K$ on $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], $b\in\mathbf Z$, and $r\in\mathbf N$ such that $H^i(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}M)=0$ for every module $M$ when $i<0$ or $b<i$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. For every $g:T\to U$, the single-rank predicate $R_1(f,E,F,g\circ\iota_U)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match] holds if and only if, for every $h:T'\to T$, $H^0(L(g\circ h)^*K)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. This statement constructs the local complex and comparison, not a representing subscheme.

proof.text: Apply exists_picardReferenceRankNeighbourhood to obtain surjectivity of f, U containing s, and r such that E has rank r on every base change over U. Apply exists_properFlatDirectImagePerfectChart to F with the prescribed U to obtain V contained in U, perfect K, bound b, tensor vanishing and H^0 comparisons. Transport the reference-rank condition from U to V by homOfLE_ι and associativity.

For a test g:T→V unfold the single-rank predicate. At each t in a further T prime choose its local witness W,n. The reference E has both ranks n and r on X_W. Surjectivity of the base-changed morphism supplies a point over t in W; the stalk-finrank theorem gives n=r. Tensor pullback along W inclusion equals ordinary restriction by uniqueness of left adjoints. Glue these rank-r restrictions over their cover to obtain global rank-r direct image. Conversely restrict a global rank-r direct image to the top open; the reference E is already rank r there. The open-cover argument includes empty schemes.

For every further h:T prime→T apply the chart comparison at h composed with g. Rewrite associativity to put its ordinary direct image in the exact shape of the fixed-rank equivalence. Transport finite local freeness of rank r along this isomorphism in both directions and retain K, b, r and the neighbourhood V.
